name: dark-bedroom-rebellious-selfie
image_purpose: alternative styling, room atmosphere, and flash mirror reference

prompt.project_info: Create a 0.5x wide-angle mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in a dark LED-lit bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with messy space buns and colorful clips, heavy alternative makeup, septum piercing, oversized black hoodie, opaque black pleated skirt or shorts, opaque tights, and chunky platform boots.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated cross-legged on an unmade bed, phone with generic decorative stickers held in front of the face, full-length mirror framed with polaroids, posters, stuffed animals, purple-blue LED strips, fingerprints and smudges.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh smartphone flash with purple-blue ambient LED glow, starburst reflection, vignetted edges, digital grain, chaotic digital-native mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone 0.5x ultra-wide mirror selfie, portrait 9:16, controlled distortion, sharp flash highlights, natural room detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult alternative-fashion woman with messy space buns and colorful clips takes a 0.5x mirror selfie while seated cross-legged on a messy bed, wearing an oversized black hoodie, opaque black skirt or shorts, opaque tights, and chunky platform boots. Use generic decorative phone stickers, polaroid-covered mirror, posters, stuffed animals, purple-blue LEDs, harsh flash, and realistic smudges. No exposed skin emphasis or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, fishnet tights, garter, lingerie, exposed underwear, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted legs, extra fingers, warped mirror, unreadable text, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
